title: Hearty Congratulations — Faculty Research Award & Academic Excellence
summary: Management, Principal, and Staff warmly congratulate faculty members on securing national research grants and publishing in Scopus-indexed journals.
content: The Management of Mysore Diocesan Educational Society (Regd.), the Rector, Principal, and Staff of St. Philomena's College (Autonomous), Mysuru, take immense pride and joy in extending our heartiest congratulations on the remarkable academic and research achievement.
Your dedicated contribution towards research innovation, scholarly publications, and mentoring students has brought immense prestige to the institution.
We wish you continued success in all your future academic and research endeavors. May your dedication continue to inspire our student community.
signatory:
Rev. Dr. Bernard Prakash Barnis
Rector & Principal

title: Autonomous End-Semester Examination Time Table (Theory & Practical) 2026
summary: The Office of the Controller of Examinations has released the official schedule for UG & PG End-Semester Examinations.
content: It is hereby notified to all Undergraduate (B.A., B.Sc., B.Com., B.B.A., B.C.A., B.S.W., B.Voc.) and Postgraduate (M.Sc., M.Com., M.A., M.S.W.) students that the Autonomous End-Semester Theory and Practical Examinations are scheduled as per the annexed timetable.
Hall tickets can be collected from the respective department coordinators upon clearance of institutional dues.
Strict compliance with examination code of conduct and reporting time (30 minutes prior to bell) is mandatory for all candidates.
signatory:
Controller of Examinations
St. Philomena's College (Autonomous)
department: Office of the Controller of Examinations

title: UG & PG Online Admissions Open for Academic Session 2026–2027
summary: Applications are open for B.Sc, BCA, B.Com, BBA, BA, BSW, B.Voc, M.Sc, M.Com, MA, and MSW autonomous degree programs.
content: Applications are invited from eligible candidates for admission into various Undergraduate and Postgraduate Autonomous Degree Programmes for the academic year 2026–2027.
Candidates can submit applications online via the admission portal or visit the College Admissions Helpdesk between 9:00 AM and 4:00 PM on all working days.
Merit-based scholarships and diocesan financial support are available for deserving candidates.

title: NEP 2020 Skill Enhancement Courses & Value-Added Course Selection Guidelines
summary: Undergraduate students in Semester III & V must submit their elective choices for digital literacy, environmental studies, and soft skills.
content: All III and V Semester Undergraduate students under the National Education Policy (NEP 2020) curriculum are hereby directed to submit their choices for Skill Enhancement (SEC) and Value-Added Courses (VAC).
Course options include Cyber Security Fundamentals, Digital Marketing, AI & Society, Communicative French, and Environmental Bio-monitoring.
The selection portal will remain active until the deadline. Late submissions will result in automated system allotment.
signatory:
Dean of Academic Affairs
St. Philomena's College

title: Parent-Teacher Interactive Meeting & Academic Progress Review Notice
summary: Circular regarding the Parent-Teacher Meeting (PTM) for reviewing attendance, continuous internal assessments, and student mentoring.
content: A Parent-Teacher Interactive Meeting (PTM) is convened for parents and guardians of all undergraduate and postgraduate students to discuss student academic progress, attendance percentage, and overall development.
Parents are requested to interact directly with mentors, subject faculties, and heads of departments.
Continuous Internal Assessment (CIA) marks and attendance records will be made available for review.

title: National Conference on Emerging Trends in AI, Quantum Computing & Cyber Forensics
summary: Two-day national academic symposium organized by the Post Graduate Department of Computer Science in association with IQAC.
content: The Post Graduate Department of Computer Science, in collaboration with Internal Quality Assurance Cell (IQAC), cordially invites academicians, research scholars, and industry professionals to the two-day National Conference.
Keynote addresses will be delivered by distinguished scientists from IISc Bangalore, DRDO, and premier IT corporations.
signatory: Head, PG Dept. of Computer Science & IQAC Coordinator

title: Campus Placement Drive 2026 — JK Tyre & IT Corporate Recruiters
summary: Campus recruitment drive by JK Tyre & Industries, Infosys, and Banking Corporations for graduating final year students.
content: The Training and Placement Cell announces the Mega Campus Placement Drive for final year students across B.Sc., B.Com., B.B.A., B.C.A., M.Sc., and M.Com. disciplines.

title: PHILOFEST 2026 — Annual Inter-Collegiate Cultural & Literary Fest
summary: Over 35 premier institutions competing across 25 dynamic literary, performing arts, debating, and music competitions.
content: The Student Welfare Council and Cultural Committee proudly present 'PHILOFEST 2026', a vibrant confluence of student talent, creativity, and inter-collegiate camaraderie.

title: Annual Athletic Meet & Inter-Departmental Sports Championship 2026
summary: Annual Track & Field Athletic Meet and Sports Championship with march-past, track events, and championship trophies.
content: The Department of Physical Education invites all staff and students to the Annual Athletic Meet & Sports Championship 2026.
signatory: Director of Physical Education & Sports Committee
